_note: Tool definitions as sent to Sarvam configure_app_tool for agent Samadhan-Me-589b92a5-633b. Recreate each with configure_app_tool(agent_id, tool_type, name, description, connector_config), then agents(operation='set_tools', params={'enable': [run tool names]}). Base URL and X-Samadhan-Key are placeholders.

tools.name: call_started
tools.description: Lifecycle hook (on_start). Opens or resumes the merchant's case and records the call session before the agent speaks. Not called by the LLM.

tools.name: call_ended
tools.description: Lifecycle hook (on_end). Closes the call session and, if a write action happened without proof being sent (e.g. the call dropped), sends the written confirmation anyway. Not called by the LLM.

tools.name: get_merchant_context
tools.description: Call this FIRST in every conversation. Looks up the merchant by the caller's phone number (or by a registered mobile number the caller speaks) and returns shop, billing, device, plan, settlement-hold and case status in one call, including case_ref, merchant_id, returning_caller, pending_approval and actions_already_taken_text.

body.name: transcript
body.description: One or two sentences in English summarising what the caller has said so far about their problem, e.g. 'My shop has closed. Please take the Soundbox back.'

body.name: registered_phone
body.description: Optional. Only fill this when the caller speaks a registered mobile number different from the number they are calling from (for example after the account was not found). Digits only, e.g. 9000000001. Leave empty otherwise.

body.name: merchant_id
body.description: The merchant_id exactly as returned by get_merchant_context.

tools.name: check_promised_plan
tools.description: Read-only promise check. Compares the plan sales promised the merchant against the plan actually billed and returns whether there is a mismatch and the overcharge amount. When mismatch is true, call raise_refund_request next.

body.name: merchant_id
body.description: The merchant_id exactly as returned by get_merchant_context.

tools.name: stop_billing_and_pickup
tools.description: Write action for a closed shop. Stops billing from the request date, raises a credit note for the period since closure, and books a device pickup. Call only after the merchant confirms they want to close, and only if actions_already_taken_text does not already cover it. Afterwards call send_confirmation.

body.name: merchant_id
body.description: The merchant_id exactly as returned by get_merchant_context.

body.name: reason
body.description: Short English reason for closure in the merchant's words, e.g. 'shop permanently closed'.

body.name: idempotency_key
body.description: Exactly '<case_ref>:closure', using case_ref from get_merchant_context, e.g. 'SMD-1042:closure'. Never use the interaction id.

mock.body: {"ok": true, "ref": "SMD-1042", "billing_stopped_from": "2026-11-14", "device_status": "pickup_scheduled", "credit_note_ref": "CN-5521", "credit_note_amount": 1000.0, "credit_note_amount_text": "₹1,000.00", "credit_note_period": "12 March 2026 to 14 November 2026", "pickup_ref": "PU-8841", "pickup_date": "2026-11-19", "pickup_address": "Shop 14, Moosapet Main Road, Hyderabad 500018", "say": "I have stopped the billing from today. A credit note of 1000 rupees has been raised for the period since your shop closed in March. Pickup of the Soundbox is booked for the nineteenth of November, and I will send you a written confirmation with these details."}

tools.name: device_troubleshoot
tools.description: Guided Soundbox troubleshooting, one step at a time. Start with step 0, then pass back the next_step from the previous response. When steps run out the backend books a technician (technician_booked true).

body.name: merchant_id
body.description: The merchant_id exactly as returned by get_merchant_context.

body.name: symptom
body.description: The device problem the caller describes. Use unknown if it does not clearly match.

body.name: step
body.description: Troubleshooting step number. 0 on the first call; afterwards the next_step value returned by the previous device_troubleshoot call.

body.name: idempotency_key
body.description: Exactly '<case_ref>:device:<step>', using case_ref from get_merchant_context and the step being sent, e.g. 'SMD-1045:device:0'. Never use the interaction id.

mock.body: {"ok": true, "resolved": false, "next_step": 1, "technician_booked": false, "say": "Let us try one thing. Press and hold the power button for ten seconds until you hear a beep, then tell me what you hear."}

connector_config.resp_template: ok={{ok}}; resolved={{resolved}}; next_step={{next_step}}; technician_booked={{technician_booked}}; ticket_ref={{ticket_ref}}; technician_date={{technician_date}}; device_status={{device_status}}; instruction={{say}}; reason={{reason}}
connector_config.on_failure: Our system is not responding right now. I will connect you to a colleague.

tools.name: raise_refund_request
tools.description: Queues a refund request for a human colleague to approve. Never pays money. Call after check_promised_plan returns mismatch true. Do NOT call if pending_approval is already true. Never tell the caller a refund is approved or paid.

body.name: merchant_id
body.description: The merchant_id exactly as returned by get_merchant_context.

body.name: amount
body.description: Refund amount in rupees as a number with 2 decimals, copied exactly from overcharge_amount returned by check_promised_plan, e.g. 868.00. Never calculate it yourself.

body.name: reason
body.description: Short English reason, e.g. 'promised Rs 1/month promo, billed Rs 125/month for 7 months'.

body.name: idempotency_key
body.description: Exactly '<case_ref>:refund', using case_ref from get_merchant_context, e.g. 'SMD-1043:refund'. Never use the interaction id.

mock.body: {"ok": true, "request_ref": "RF-2207", "amount": 868.0, "amount_text": "₹868.00", "status": "awaiting_approval", "expected_decision_by": "2026-11-15", "say": "I have raised a refund request for 868 rupees, reference RF-2207. A colleague has to approve any money that goes out, so this will be reviewed by tomorrow and you will get a message with the decision."}

connector_config.on_failure: Our system is not responding right now. I will connect you to a colleague.

tools.name: handover_to_human
tools.description: Passes the case to a human colleague with a summary so the caller does not repeat themselves. Use for cash-in-hand requests, legal threats, abuse, or any request no other tool covers. After it returns, transfer the call.

body.name: merchant_id
body.description: The merchant_id exactly as returned by get_merchant_context. Use 'unknown' if the merchant was not found.

body.name: reason
body.description: Short English reason for the handover, e.g. 'merchant asking for immediate cash refund'.

body.name: transcript
body.description: The conversation so far in English, as complete as you can: what the caller asked, what you checked, what was already done, with any reference numbers.

body.name: idempotency_key
body.description: Exactly '<case_ref>:handover', using case_ref from get_merchant_context, e.g. 'SMD-1042:handover'. Never use the interaction id.

mock.body: {"ok": true, "summary_ref": "HO-1180", "case_ref": "SMD-1042", "say": "I am connecting you to a colleague now. I have passed on everything we discussed, so you will not have to explain it again."}

connector_config.on_failure: I could not pass on the notes automatically, but I am connecting you to a colleague now. Please tell them your registered mobile number.

tools.name: send_confirmation
tools.description: The Prove step. Sends the merchant a written confirmation (WhatsApp) built from everything recorded on the case: dates, amounts and reference numbers. Call after any write action (closure, refund request, technician booking) before ending the call.

body.name: merchant_id
body.description: The merchant_id exactly as returned by get_merchant_context.

body.name: idempotency_key
body.description: Exactly '<case_ref>:proof', using case_ref from get_merchant_context, e.g. 'SMD-1042:proof'. Never use the interaction id.

mock.body: {"ok": true, "proof_ref": "PR-9043", "channel": "whatsapp", "sent_to": "+919000000001", "say": "I have sent a written confirmation to your registered mobile number with the dates and the reference numbers."}
